description: A data scientist is a skilled professional responsible for collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and interpreting large volumes of data to derive actionable insights that support business decision-making. They employ statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and various data processing tools to explore data, build predictive models, and validate results. Data scientists also develop scalable data pipelines, ensure data quality, and create visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings effectively.
